name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents. Capability contracts live in openspec (specs fleet-native-transcript and subagent-context-injection; the changes under openspec/changes/ for the rest); fork doc chapters live in docs/fork-extensions.md.

knownDebt.reason: ~72 pi-lens blocking findings across ~40 upstream-original files (no-unknown-returns, require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as, unchecked-throwing-call, error-swallowing) plus known false positives. By the 2026-09-17 decision the fork keeps upstream code byte-identical instead of adding per-site suppressions; re-checked on each sync.
Overrides intentionally stay broad: narrowing them re-enables ~11k anti-slop errors across ~436 upstream files that upstream never satisfied. Accepted debt.
The intentional broad overrides block adds a comma to the upstream closing brace; the single raw-vs-w line is that comma.

test:smoke:tool-activation fails locally: TypeError: SettingsManager.inMemory is not a function. The package devDependency aliases @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to the test shim (test/fixtures/pi-coding-agent-shim, 0.87.0), whose SettingsManager and DefaultResourceLoader are empty stubs, so this smoke script needs an environment where the real pi package resolves; it is not part of test:unit or test:all. The unit suite is green.

Upstream-original signature spawnRunner(cfg: object, ...) (upstream 649, and cfg: object at upstream 420) kept byte-identical per the 2026-09-17 decision: no per-site retyping or suppressions inside upstream files. Finding re-checked each sync.
